d: Michelle joins a traveling circus and learns how to perform iconic circus acts in front of a live crowd.

t: I Joined The #1 Cheer Team In America
d: Michelle chases a childhood dream by trying out for the University of Kentucky's top cheerleading team. With only 10 days to train, she takes on tough tumbling, stunts, and dance challenges, to see if she can make the cut.

t: I Competed In A Beauty Pageant For The First Time
d: Michelle experiences a 60-day intensive pageant training program with a professional pageant coach, focusing on fitness, interview techniques, and stage presence, to prepare for a Miss USA competition.
Michelle reflects on her pageant journey, answers viewer questions, and shares honest insights about confidence, self-image, and the world of beauty competitions.

t: I Trained Like A Victoria's Secret Model for 5 Weeks
d: Michelle follows the rigorous diet and workouts of Victoria's Secret models to uncover what it really takes to build and maintain the body of a professional swimsuit model.

Michelle joins the South Metro Fire Rescue team, pushing through grueling physical tests and entering a blazing structure fire to experience the intense mental and physical demands firefighters face when saving lives.

t: I Ran A Marathon In The Hottest Place On Earth
d: Michelle attempts to run a marathon in the hottest place on Earth, Death Valley.
Michelle spends a day working alongside San Diego's sanitation workers to experience the challenges, dangers, and hard work behind one of America's most lethal and essential jobs.
Michelle trains at the United States Secret Service Academy, experiencing firsthand the exclusive and demanding world of America's top protection agents.
Michelle enrolls at the International Butler Academy alongside other students training to serve the highest levels of society.
Michelle attempts to escape Harry Houdini's famous Water Torture Cell with only 6 weeks of training.

t: I Trained Like A Chess Grandmaster
d: Michelle studies chess for 8 months to see if she can win her first-ever chess tournament.
